shared_elements: low-relief carving on weathered pale stone
quadruped animal shown in profile with legs extended
horizontal band of repeated pattern acting as a divider
registers or bands stacked one above another
justification: Both are shallow relief carvings in a warm-toned stone that combine profile quadrupeds, small disc motifs and a horizontal band of repeating pattern separating zones of imagery. Beyond that the correspondence is generic: A is a wide, horizontally continuous, densely crowded narrative with finely incised interior detail (chariot, spoked wheels, human bodies), while B is a vertical, sparsely filled pillar face with isolated, flattened silhouette animals and almost no internal modelling.
